title: Main Deck Cargo Floor Panel — Edge Elongation and Insert Repair
abstract: Permanent repair for elongated fastener holes and local edge damage in the main deck cargo floor panels, using a bonded insert that restores the seat before a new panel is installed.

sections.purpose: This repair restores an elongated fastener hole or a locally damaged edge in a main deck cargo floor panel seat, so that a new panel can be fitted without replacing the underlying floor structure.
sections.damage_assessment: Check every seat with the seat gauge after the panel is removed. Elongation up to 1.2 mm on the major axis, at no more than four holes per bay and with no two adjacent, is inside this repair. Elongation above 1.2 mm, more than four holes per bay, two adjacent holes, or any crack running from a hole into the panel seat web, is outside it.
sections.repair_procedure: Ream the elongated hole to the first oversize on repair drawing RD-53-50-13-006 and check for roundness. Do a dye penetrant inspection of the reamed hole. Prepare the bore to the bonding standard and install the insert wet with structural adhesive, holding it with the setting tool until cure. Ream the insert bore to the nominal screw size. Where the aft floor gusset kit D5350137657469 or the forward splice plate sub-assembly ES657922-93 lies under the repaired seat, check that the insert does not protrude into the fastener land on the item below; the drawing gives the maximum protrusion. Apply the chromate-free primer to all disturbed surfaces. Install the panel with countersunk screws AGS895094-3D at the pitch for the aircraft standard and torque them to the normal value; the repaired hole takes the same torque. Do the distributed floor loading check for the repaired bay before the cabin is rebuilt over it.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is not life limited but is limited in number: no more than four repaired seats per bay and no more than sixteen per aircraft. Do a seat gauge check of every repaired hole whenever the panel above it is removed. An insert that has rotated or loosened invalidates the repair and the seat must then be assessed for a structural repair. Record every repaired seat position in the aircraft records so that the count per bay can be tracked.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Elongation up to 1.2 mm on the major axis, no more than four holes per bay, no two adjacent, and no crack running from a hole into the seat web.
